title: feat(app-shell): show a disable refused for a dependent validation rule whole on the Setup packages page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao8FStJxkcthsASPRhE7tkGn)_

Fixes #31003

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 软件包详情里，停用被服务端以 409 `PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE` 拒绝时，页面先用管理员的语言显示一句标题(为什么不能停用、先停用或修改规则)，再完整显示服务端原话(包 · 对象 · 规则，以及补救办法)，不再只露第一句、把补救藏在「更多」后面。停用确认框里多一行，说明有规则依赖这个包时停用可能会被拒绝。
- 为什么改：#30825 之后停用可能被拒，但页面把「停用」画成随时可用，被拒时补救办法又被折叠，管理员看不出该先去关哪条规则。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端显示和两条新文案(en/zh)，其它拒绝码的显示方式不变，服务端零改动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`PackagesPage.tsx` 里 `run()` 的 catch(按错误码加 heading)和消息框的渲染分支；确认框里新增的 `pkg-detail-disable-may-refuse` 一行；测试文件末尾新的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.moduleDisable-28118.test.tsx`，预期 15 passed，其中 en、zh 两条 409 用例都看到标题和完整原话。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` (package detail sheet):

- **The refusal, drawn whole.** When an action on the sheet fails with error code `PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE` (read off the thrown error with `errorCodeIs`, which `apiJson` already fills from the ADR-0112 envelope), the message box draws a heading in the reader's language (`engine.packages.detail.disableRestricted`), and under it the server's whole message as sent. The server's message names every blocking rule as package · object · rule and then the remedy. Before, `RefusalMessage` cut it to its first sentence, so the remedy was behind "More". Every other refusal is drawn as before (`RefusalMessage`).
- **Disable no longer reads as unconditional.** The confirm dialog gains one line (`engine.packages.detail.disableMayBeRefused`) saying the disable is refused while an active validation rule reads a field this package adds, and the refusal names each rule. Offering Disable still follows the served `disableable` verdict alone. Nothing is computed in the client.

`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`: the two new keys. They are in the lazy `studio` namespace, not the eager `i18n-locale-en` pack, so no ceiling moves.

### What the server serves (measured on `origin/main` `8ae0ab9b`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`)

- `PATCH /packages/:id/disable` answers `deps.error(disableDependentRulesMessage(...), 409, { code })`. On the wire that is `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`, with no `error.details`. The JSDoc on the constant `PACKAGE_DISABLE_RESTRICTED_BY_VALIDATION_RULE` says a machine-readable shape for the triples would be a spec contract first. The page therefore shows the message and does not parse it.
- The served `disableable` is `isDisableablePackage` (a writable base, or a module of an installed app). It does not read `readDisableDependentRules`. Pre-computing it per row would need that server read on every `GET /packages` row (a fold of every object per package) and a change in what the field means. That is outside this card's fence (`packages/**`), so the page shows the refusal when the disable is attempted.

## Tests

`PackagesPage.moduleDisable-28118.test.tsx` gets a new top-level describe, `a disable the server refuses for a dependent validation rule (objectstack#31003)`, in the existing module-disable harness. Its wire stub gains an optional per-door answer. The describe has 5 cases:

- the confirm dialog carries the may-be-refused line beside the existing consequence copy;
- **en** and **zh**: a 409 with the code draws the heading in that language and the server's whole sentence (rule listing and remedy both on screen, no "More"), and Disable stays on offer;
- CONTROL: another refusal code (403 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`, two sentences) keeps the first-sentence drawing with "More" and no heading;
- CONTROL: a disable with no dependent rule lands in one confirm (one `PATCH …/disable`, success line, no refusal drawn).

The suite also gains module-top warm imports of `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`, which `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test whose reach loads them lazily.

## Acceptance notes

- The heading is console copy and the listing stays the server's English sentence. Translating the listing would need the package · object · rule triples as data (`error.details`), which is a `packages/spec` contract and not opened here.
- The heading is keyed on the error code, not on the door, so the same drawing would apply to that code wherever the sheet's `run()` meets it. Today only the disable door answers it on this sheet. The install door also answers it for `enableOnInstall: false`, but that door belongs to the import flow and is not touched here.

## Verification

Head `0b6d41bd`, tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack`.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.moduleDisable-28118.test.tsx`: Tests 15 passed (15), 10 existing and 5 new.
- Every `PackagesPage.*.test.tsx` (18 files) on the first head: 17 passed, plus 1 failure in the new zh case (the test clicked the English label), fixed in the next commit. The file is green since then.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace.test.ts`: 18 passed (en ⊆ zh, placeholder parity).
- Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `{msg.kind === 'err' && msg.heading ? (` → `… && false ? (`): the en and zh 409 cases fail (2 failed, 13 passed). Restored to a blob equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 36 of 36 run</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 36 lines. All 36 were run with stdin redirected from /dev/null, and `--ran` reports `36 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. On the first pass, 34 exited 0 and 2 exited 1:

- `pnpm check:test-source-alias`: the edited suite reaches lazy `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` imports. Fixed with the warm imports. Exit 0 on `0b6d41bd`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 7 failures in `check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts` and `spec-symbol-ledger-plugin-detail-7265.test.ts`. Both read `@objectstack/spec` declarations, and this worktree's spec was built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`. After `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, the full run on `0b6d41bd` gives Test Files 170 passed and 2 skipped; Tests 4991 passed and 2 skipped; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

Also run beyond the derivation, all exit 0: `pnpm --dir ui check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (neither new key is listed), `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `pnpm check:undeclared-dep-imports`. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is among the derived 36.

</details>

<details><summary>Not run locally</summary>

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` is NOT MEASURED. This worktree's `@object-ui/*` packages have no `.d.ts`, so the run reports about 1,700 missing-module errors (TS2307 and TS7006), and none of them is on a line this diff adds. Type Check UI runs it.

</details>
